subject: general
question: O is the mother of A. B is the mother of C and E. C and D are the brothers and son's of A. G is the daughter of E and cousin of F. F is the son of D. How is B related to F?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: 

1) O is the mother of A.

2) C and D are the brothers and sons of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb3fc36d72390a2247b1cce08e6660c23bae1861a0d368df408dd2ecb286fb7a.png] 

3) B is the mother of C and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b81c9db64c3e8d127df5346c879b8341957477d60e2afe28957f08738018277d.png] 

4) G is the daughter of E and cousin of F.

5) F is the son of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b17939c51c6843fa7540e6a2d9f27936e07f1aa036af1e82b6b852512fad4db.png] 

Thus, B is the F's paternal grandmother or father's mother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
